trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl a game — follow-through is the advice the description gives, so finish the motion on each throw. One game is enough.
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Bowl a game, following through on each throw.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). PlayStation tracks 500 choices for this one, so it is a long accumulation of decisions made across the game. Keep playing and choosing — every choice counts, and the counter climbs over the whole playthrough. There is no way to rush it; it is a reward for playing the game.
steps: Keep playing and making choices wherever the game offers them.
Reach 500 choices on the PlayStation counter.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. A drive-by with a melee weapon — swing from a moving vehicle and knock someone down. Pick a slow drive and a clear target; speed makes the swing harder to land.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills are dirty money that has to be cleaned through your contacts — launder $250,000 of them. The counter is tracked by PlayStation, so every bill you clean counts; the money comes from the crime side, so pair this with the robbery trophies.
steps: Earn Marked Bills through crime and heists.
Launder them through your contacts until $250,000 is cleaned.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Any shops, any goods — the total is what matters. Big purchases count fastest, so save the expensive buys for this one and the counter will climb. It pairs well with the garage properties and the vehicle hunts.
steps: Shop across Leonida's stores.
Spend $100,000 in total.
